description: This is a test specification file using the Playwright testing framework, which tests the 'browser_install' functionality with a client and mcpBrowser dependencies.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case named 'browser_install' that runs asynchronously, skipping if mcpBrowser is not 'chromium' and performing an expectation on the client call tool response.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Used to assert conditions on the response returned from the call to 'client.callTool', specifically checking that tabs contain the string 'No open tabs'.
